{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
df_filtered = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the filtered group
print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE patients: {len(df_filtered)}")

# Count how many responded (responded == 1)
num_responded = df_filtered['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = num_responded / len(df_filtered)

print(f"Number responded: {num_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")

# Return the fraction
fraction_responded"}
